title: Chargen resource backpacks
creator: Softmax / Polyworld contributors, authored with OpenAI Codex
process: Original procedural Blender geometry fitted to the canonical Chargen peon and shared rig. Exported as one independently selectable Back mesh per resource. No textures or third-party models were added.
reference_generation: OpenAI image_gen from user-provided screenshots of the Polyworld Chargen peon; exact prompts retained in prompts.json.
user_corrections: Do not model tree rings in geometry.
attachment: Cargo is rigid on Spine2; the shoulder straps inherit the tunic weights.
runtime: LvD preloads merged peon variants and selects the backpack from current cargo without changing simulation state. Existing animations are reused; no new animation clips are shipped.
notes: The references guide proportions and materials; the final meshes use plain log ends and a larger sack following the user correction.

runtime_review.renderer: Polyworld CharacterScene / ToonCharacters, the same merged skinning path as LvD
checks: Both backpack choices preserve one merged mesh and one draw primitive per peon
Existing clip availability, canonical rig and normalized weights
Gold and wood harvest-to-deposit lifecycle and interrupted orders
